2607.25914.title: Toward Standardized Cross-Vendor Agent Tool Trust Management in Autonomous Networks
2607.25914.paper_summary: Autonomous Network Levels 4-5 require AI agents to invoke tools across vendor boundaries without human oversight, yet existing management standards lack a standardized mechanism for cross-vendor trust visibility. When a tool from Vendor B is compromised, agents from Vendor A continue invoking it -- unaware of the trust degradation -- causing cascading service impact. We present AgentToolMO, a proposed 3GPP NRM information model for agent tool trust management. The model comprises: a formally defined trust state machine with provable graduated enforcement, damped cascade propagation with bounded convergence, cross-vendor trust notifications via existing Management Services (MnS) interfaces, and retroactive impact assessment through NRM dependency graph traversal. Simulation-based evaluation across multi-vendor topologies shows that standardized cross-vendor notifications reduce blast radius from hours-scale undetected propagation to near-real-time containment bounded by MnS notification delivery, with cascade convergence guaranteed in bounded iterations and sub-linear notification scaling across vendor domains. The framework operates within existing 3GPP management infrastructure, leverages existing protocols, and provides a standardization pathway for trustworthy multi-vendor autonomous network management.
2607.25914.paper_summary_zh: 自主網絡的第4-5級要求AI代理在沒有人工監督的情況下跨供應商邊界調用工具，但現有的管理標準缺乏跨供應商信任可見性的標準化機制。當供應商B的工具受到損害時，供應商A的代理仍然繼續調用它——對信任降級毫不知情——導致連鎖服務影響。我們提出了AgentToolMO，這是一個為代理工具信任管理而提出的3GPP NRM信息模型。該模型包括：一個形式上定義的信任狀態機，具有可證明的漸進執行，受限收斂的阻尼級聯傳播，通過現有的管理服務（MnS）接口進行的跨供應商信任通知，以及通過NRM依賴圖遍歷進行的回溯影響評估。在多供應商拓撲上的基於模擬的評估顯示，標準化的跨供應商通知將未被檢測的傳播的爆炸半徑從小時級別減少到接近實時的限制，受限於MnS通知的交付，並且在有限的迭代中保證級聯收斂，跨供應商領域的通知擴展為次線性。該框架在現有的3GPP管理基礎設施內運行，利用現有的協議，並為值得信賴的多供應商自主網絡管理提供了一條標準化的途徑。
